meta.densityMeaning: sum of per-source line-of-sight distance likelihoods per Cartesian voxel
limitations: The supplied FITS file has no per-star uncertainty or covariance columns.
The Oden 0.10-mag calibration uncertainty is applied as an independent marginal kernel; correlated systematics are not represented.
This observed likelihood field cannot be interpreted as intrinsic physical line-of-sight depth.

antiAliasKernel.distribution: isotropic Gaussian on the Cartesian voxel grid
antiAliasKernel.role: numerical density-estimator anti-aliasing, not an astrophysical distance error

source.name: Oden et al. 2025 author-supplied Gaia red-clump catalog

uncertaintyProvenance.statement: The empirical M_G/color calibration contributes approximately 0.10 mag uncertainty.
